name: Nateglinide
patient_counselling: Stimulates rapid short-duration insulin release.
pregnancy_category: Fastest onset meglitinide~60mg for elderly

name: Rosiglitazone
patient_counselling: PPAR-gamma agonist: improves insulin sensitivity.
pregnancy_category: Restricted due to MI risk~Rarely used now

name: Linagliptin
patient_counselling: Hepatoexcreted DPP-4 inhibitor - no renal adjustment needed.
pregnancy_category: ONLY DPP-4i with no renal adjustment~Longest half-life~Ideal for CKD/dialysis

name: Saxagliptin
patient_counselling: DPP-4 inhibitor prolonging incretin activity.
pregnancy_category: SAVOR-TIMI: HF signal~Renal dose adjustment required

name: Alogliptin
patient_counselling: Highly selective DPP-4 inhibitor.
pregnancy_category: Can use in dialysis at 6.25mg~Highly selective >10000x vs DPP-8/9

name: Miglitol
patient_counselling: Inhibits alpha-glucosidases in small intestine.
brand_names: Minimal systemic absorption - local gut action
pregnancy_category: Similar to acarbose~Less GI effects~Monitor LFTs

name: Dofetilide
patient_counselling: Pure class III antiarrhythmic: blocks rapid delayed rectifier K+ current (Ikr), prolonging repolarization.
pregnancy_category: INITIATION ONLY in hospital with continuous telemetry~QTc >500ms: hold/reduce~Risk of Torsades~Most effective for AF conversion

name: Lenvatinib
patient_counselling: Inhibits VEGFR1-3, FGFR1-4, PDGFR, RET, KIT. Broader FGFR inhibition than other TKIs.
pregnancy_category: Hypertension very common (68%)~Proteinuria monitor~Unique FGFR inhibition~Combination with pembrolizumab for endometrial

name: Cabozantinib
patient_counselling: Inhibits VEGFR2, MET, AXL, RET, KIT. Dual VEGFR/MET inhibition overcomes resistance.
pregnancy_category: Long half-life~Hypertension and diarrhea most common~MET inhibition overcomes resistance

name: Pazopanib
patient_counselling: Inhibits VEGFR1-3, PDGFR, KIT. Anti-angiogenic TKI.
pregnancy_category: Take 1h before or 2h after food~Hepatotoxicity monitoring essential~Hair depigmentation unique~QTc prolongation

name: Levalbuterol
patient_counselling: Active R-enantiomer of albuterol. May have less cardiac effects than racemic albuterol.
pregnancy_category: R-enantiomer theoretically fewer side effects~More expensive than albuterol~Similar efficacy to albuterol

name: Ipratropium
patient_counselling: Blocks M3 muscarinic receptors in bronchial smooth muscle, causing bronchodilation.
pregnancy_category: Longer acting than SABAs for COPD~Less effective than SABAs in asthma~Can combine with albuterol

name: Olodaterol
patient_counselling: Once-daily LABA with 24h duration. Beta-2 selective agonist.
pregnancy_category: Once daily LABA~Must use with ICS in asthma~Respimat soft mist inhaler

name: Indacaterol
patient_counselling: Once-daily LABA with 24h duration. Ultra-long acting.
pregnancy_category: Once daily LABA~COPD only (not asthma)~Good for once daily adherence

name: Aclidinium
patient_counselling: Twice-daily LAMA for COPD bronchodilation.
pregnancy_category: Twice daily LAMA~Dry mouth less than tiotropium~DPI formulation

name: Glycopyrrolate inhalation

dosage.adult: 50mcg inhaled BID (Bevespi) or 12.5mcg BID (Seebri) or 9mcg daily (Incruse)

patient_counselling: LAMA available as combination (Bevespi = glycopyrrolate/formoterol) or monotherapy.
pregnancy_category: Available as monotherapy or LABA/LAMA combo~Also used IV for secretions (different formulation)

name: Zafirlukast
patient_counselling: Blocks cysteinyl leukotriene receptor CysLT1.
pregnancy_category: Take on empty stomach~Monitor LFTs~Drug interaction with warfarin

name: Zileuton
monitoring: LFTs at baseline, monthly x3, then periodically
patient_counselling: Inhibits 5-lipoxygenase enzyme, blocking leukotriene synthesis (not just receptor blockade).
pregnancy_category: Take with food~Monitor LFTs monthly~Hepatotoxicity risk~QID dosing disadvantage

name: Ambroxol
patient_counselling: Mucolytic agent: reduces mucus viscosity by activating surfactant production and lysosomal enzymes.
pregnancy_category: More effective than bromhexine~Reduces mucus viscosity~Also has local anesthetic effect

name: Benzonatate
patient_counselling: Suppresses cough by anesthetizing stretch receptors in pulmonary inflation reflex pathway.
pregnancy_category: Do not chew/crush - risk of fatal local anesthesia of oropharynx

name: Dextromethorphan
patient_counselling: Suppresses cough center in medulla via sigma-1 receptor agonism. NMDA antagonist at high doses.
pregnancy_category: MAOIs absolutely contraindicated~Quinidine increases levels 10x (use therapeutically in pseudobulbar affect)
warnings: Common in OTC products - check interactions

name: Pseudoephedrine
patient_counselling: Alpha-1 and beta agonist: causes vasoconstriction in nasal mucosa reducing edema and congestion.
pregnancy_category: Behind pharmacy counter (pseudoephedrine law)~Avoid in uncontrolled hypertension~May worsen urinary retention in BPH~Can cause insomnia

name: Oxymetazoline

dosage.adult: 2-3 sprays per nostril BID x3-5 days (max)

patient_counselling: Topical alpha-1 agonist: potent vasoconstriction in nasal mucosa. Do not use >3-5 days to avoid rebound congestion.
pregnancy_category: Do NOT use >3-5 days - rebound congestion (rhinitis medicamentosa)

name: Xylometazoline

dosage.adult: 1 spray per nostril BID x3-5 days

patient_counselling: Topical nasal decongestant. Similar to oxymetazoline.
pregnancy_category: Do NOT use >5 days
overdose: Used for nasal congestion and sinusitis

name: Cromolyn

dosage.adult: 2 puffs QID (MDI) or 100mg nebulizer QID or nasal spray QID

patient_counselling: Prevents mast cell degranulation and histamine release. Must be used prophylactically - not rescue.
pregnancy_category: Preventive only - not for acute symptoms~Must use QID dosing~Very safe profile~Take 15-20 min before exercise or allergen exposure

name: Nedocromil
patient_counselling: Inhibits mast cell degranulation and inflammatory cell activation.
pregnancy_category: Similar to cromolyn~BID dosing advantage~Less commonly used~Not for acute symptoms

name: Aminophylline
patient_counselling: IV aminophylline (79% theophylline by weight). Used when oral theophylline not feasible.
pregnancy_category: Convert aminophylline to theophylline by multiplying by 0.79
overdose: Loading dose based on ideal body weight

name: Mianserin
patient_counselling: Alpha-2 antagonist and 5-HT2/5-HT3 antagonist. Similar to mirtazapine but more agranulocytosis risk.
pregnancy_category: Not available in US~More agranulocytosis risk than mirtazapine~Used in UK/Europe/Australia

name: Vortioxetine
patient_counselling: Multimodal mechanism: SERT inhibition + 5-HT1A agonism + 5-HT1B partial agonism + 5-HT3/5-HT7/5-HT1D antagonism. Pro-cognitive effects.
pregnancy_category: Nausea most common (30%) - take with food~Pro-cognitive benefits unique~Less sexual dysfunction than SSRIs

name: Lurasidone
contraindications: Concomitant CYP3A4 inhibitors + strong CYP2D6 inhibitors
patient_counselling: D2 and 5-HT2A antagonism. Also 5-HT7 antagonist (may improve cognition and depression).
pregnancy_category: Must take with food (increases absorption 50%)~Less weight gain/ metabolic effects than olanzapine/quetiapine~5-HT7 antagonism unique

name: Aripiprazole lauroxil
patient_counselling: Long-acting prodrug of aripiprazole. Monthly or bimonthly injection for adherence.
pregnancy_category: Every 1-2 months injection~No daily oral required~Must have tolerated oral aripiprazole first~Initiate with oral aripiprazole overlap

name: Quetiapine XR
patient_counselling: Same mechanism. XR formulation for once-daily dosing.
pregnancy_category: XR: once daily dosing~Less peak-related side effects~For bipolar depression: 300-600mg XR

name: Olanzapine pamoate LAI
patient_counselling: IM depot formulation of olanzapine. Risk of post-injection delirium/sedation syndrome (PDSS).
pregnancy_category: Post-injection delirium/sedation syndrome (PDSS) - must observe 3h after injection~Do not co-administer IM benzodiazepines within 1h

name: Ziprasidone
patient_counselling: D2 and 5-HT2A antagonism with relatively balanced receptor profile. Less metabolic effects.
pregnancy_category: Must take with food (doubles absorption)~ECG baseline and as clinically indicated~QTc prolongation~Less metabolic effects than olanzapine/quetiapine

name: Thioridazine
patient_counselling: Blocks D2 receptors with strong anticholinergic and antihistamine properties. High QTc risk.
pregnancy_category: Significant QTc prolongation - limited use~Tardive dyskinesia risk~Avoid in elderly (Beers criteria)

name: Flupentixol
patient_counselling: Thioxanthene derivative with D2 antagonism. Depot injection available.
pregnancy_category: Monthly depot injection available~Less commonly used outside UK/Europe
warnings: Low-dose (1-3mg) used for anxiety/depression in some countries

name: Fluphenazine
patient_counselling: Potent D2 antagonist. Available as long-acting decanoate for monthly injections.
pregnancy_category: Decanoate: every 2-3 weeks IM~High EPS risk~Older phenothiazine

name: Chlorpromazine
patient_counselling: Low-potency D2 antagonist with strong alpha-1, M1, H1 blockade. Sedation and hypotension limit use.
pregnancy_category: Most sedating FGAs~Strong alpha-1 blockade causes orthostatic hypotension~Antiemetic at low doses~Phenothiazine class

name: Linezolid
contraindications: None significant (serotonin syndrome with serotonergic drugs)
patient_counselling: Inhibits 50S ribosomal subunit, preventing initiation of protein synthesis. Bacteriostatic (bactericidal vs some).
pregnancy_category: Serotonin syndrome risk with serotonergic drugs~Myelosuppression monitor weekly~Lactic acidosis (mitochondrial toxicity)~Optic/peripheral neuropathy with prolonged use

name: Oritavancin
patient_counselling: Lipoglycopeptide with long half-life allowing single-dose treatment. Inhibits cell wall synthesis and disrupts membrane integrity.
pregnancy_category: Single-dose treatment for ABSSSI~Extremely long half-life~Inhibits cell wall + disrupts membrane~Transient coagulopathy

name: Dalbavancin
patient_counselling: Lipoglycopeptide with once-weekly dosing. Long half-life allows weekly administration.
pregnancy_category: Once weekly dosing~Treats ABSSSI in 1-2 doses~Long-acting glycopeptide

name: Trimetrexate
patient_counselling: DHFRI used with leucovorin rescue for PCP in TMP-SMX intolerant patients.
pregnancy_category: Requires leucovorin rescue to protect normal cells~Alternative for TMP-SMX-intolerant PCP~Bone marrow suppressive

name: Atovaquone

dosage.adult: PCP treatment: 750mg BID with food. Prophylaxis: 1500mg daily with food.

patient_counselling: Inhibits mitochondrial electron transport at complex III. High-fat meal increases absorption.
pregnancy_category: Must take with fatty food for absorption~Very long half-life~Alternative to TMP-SMX for PCP

name: Atovaquone/proguanil

dosage.adult: Prophylaxis: 1 tablet daily starting 1-2 days before travel. Treatment: 4 tablets daily x3 days.

patient_counselling: Atovaquone inhibits mitochondrial electron transport. Proguanil inhibits dihydrofolate reductase. Synergistic antimalarial.
pregnancy_category: Take with food~Start 1-2 days before travel, continue 4 weeks after~One of best tolerated malaria prophylaxis

name: Colistin (polymyxin E)

dosage.adult: IM/IV: 2.5-5mg/kg/day in divided doses. Inhaled: 75-150mg BID.

patient_counselling: Disrupts Gram-negative outer membrane by binding LPS, causing cell death. Concentration-dependent killing.
pregnancy_category: Nephrotoxicity is dose-limiting~Monitor renal function daily~Inhaled form for lung infections (Pseudomonas in CF/ventilator pneumonia)~Last resort for MDR Gram-negatives

name: Fosfomycin

dosage.adult: UTI: 3g single dose PO. IV: for serious infections.

patient_counselling: Unique mechanism: inhibits MurA (cell wall synthesis). Broad-spectrum. Low resistance development.
pregnancy_category: Single-dose UTI treatment~3g in water~Also available IV (investigational in US)~Synergistic with beta-lactams~Low resistance development

name: Fosfomycin/tobramycin
patient_counselling: Fosfomycin + tobramycin: synergistic activity against MDR Gram-negatives.
pregnancy_category: Combination for synergy against resistant organisms
warnings: Available in some countries as IV formulation

name: Esomeprazole
patient_counselling: S-enantiomer of omeprazole: better CYP2C19 inhibition providing more consistent acid suppression.
pregnancy_category: S-enantiomer of omeprazole~More consistent acid suppression than racemic omeprazole

name: Famotidine
patient_counselling: Competitively blocks histamine H2 receptors on parietal cells, reducing basal and stimulated acid secretion.
pregnancy_category: Good for nocturnal acid breakthrough~Less drug interactions than PPIs~Can be used IV for stress ulcer prophylaxis

name: Nizatidine
patient_counselling: H2 receptor antagonist. Slightly less CYP inhibition than cimetidine.
pregnancy_category: Good oral bioavailability~Fewer drug interactions than cimetidine~Also promotes gastric emptying

name: Granisetron

dosage.adult: 1mg IV/PO q12h or 2mg PO daily (Sancuso patch 72h)

patient_counselling: Selective 5-HT3 antagonist. Also available as transdermal patch.
pregnancy_category: Transdermal patch (Sancuso) for 72h coverage~Also available as IV

name: Palonosetron
patient_counselling: Longest-acting 5-HT3 antagonist: most effective for delayed CINV. Allosteric binding causes receptor internalization.
pregnancy_category: Most effective for delayed CINV (days 2-4)
warnings: Single IV dose for delayed CINV

name: Aprepitant

dosage.adult: 125mg PO day 1, then 80mg days 2-3 (with 5-HT3 antagonist + dexamethasone)

patient_counselling: NK1 receptor antagonist: blocks substance P in brainstem emetic center. Synergistic with 5-HT3 antagonists for CINV.
pregnancy_category: Triple therapy: aprepitant + ondansetron + dexamethasone for highly emetogenic CINV~Also available as IV (Fosaprepitant)~Day 1: 125mg, Days 2-3: 80mg

name: Netupitant/palonosetron

dosage.adult: 1 capsule PO day 1 (highly emetogenic) or 3 capsules (moderately emetogenic)

patient_counselling: Fixed-dose combination: netupitant (NK1) + palonosetron (5-HT3). Synergistic dual mechanism.
pregnancy_category: Single capsule convenience~Dual mechanism in one dose~Most effective single-agent CINV prophylaxis

name: Aprepitant/fosaprepitant

dosage.adult: 150mg IV single dose on day 1 (equivalent to 3-day oral aprepitant)

patient_counselling: IV prodrug of aprepitant. Single IV dose replaces 3-day oral regimen. Phosphorylated for water solubility.
pregnancy_category: Single IV dose for 3-day CINV coverage~Infusion site reactions common (30-50%)~Administer over 15-30 min~Pre-medicate with corticosteroid if needed

name: Polyethylene glycol 3350
patient_counselling: High molecular weight PEG: osmotically retains water in colon, softening stool and increasing motility.
pregnancy_category: Gentle osmotic laxative~Can mix with any beverage~Onset 1-3 days~Generally well tolerated

name: Sodium picosulfate
patient_counselling: Prodrug: converted by colonic bacteria to active metabolite, stimulating colonic motility.
pregnancy_category: Used in bowel prep combinations~Requires bacterial activation in colon~Also available with magnesium citrate (Prepopik)

name: Sennosides
patient_counselling: Anthraquinone glycosides converted by colonic bacteria to rheanthrone, stimulating peristalsis.
pregnancy_category: Natural plant-based laxative~Take at bedtime for morning effect~Avoid long-term use (melanosis coli)

name: Docusate
patient_counselling: Surface-active agent: lowers surface tension, allowing water and fat to penetrate stool.
pregnancy_category: Does not stimulate motility - just softens stool~Preventive not therapeutic~Often combined with stimulant laxatives

name: Sodium sulfate/potassium sulfate/magnesium sulfate
patient_counselling: Isotonic solution: causes voluminous watery diarrhea for complete bowel cleansing. PEG-based prep.
pregnancy_category: Start 3-4 hours before procedure~Adequate hydration essential~Contraindicated in obstruction~Many proprietary alternatives available

name: Bictegravir

dosage.adult: 50mg PO daily (in fixed-dose combination with TAF/FTC)

patient_counselling: Blocks HIV integrase: prevents viral DNA from integrating into host genome.
pregnancy_category: Available as single-tablet regimen (bictegravir/TAF/FTC)

name: Cabotegravir LA

dosage.adult: Loading: 600mg IM day 1 + day 2, then 400mg IM monthly

patient_counselling: Long-acting injectable INSTI: nanosuspension for IM depot, releasing drug over 1-2 months.
pregnancy_category: Monthly or bimonthly injections~Eliminates daily pill burden~FDA-approved for both treatment (Cabenuva) and PrEP (Apretude)

name: Doravirine
patient_counselling: Inhibits HIV-1 reverse transcriptase by binding to allosteric site.
pregnancy_category: Newer NNRTI with fewer drug interactions than efavirenz/rilpivirine

name: Fostemsavir
patient_counselling: Binds gp120 on HIV envelope, preventing initial attachment to CD4 receptors. First-in-class attachment inhibitor.
pregnancy_category: New mechanism for treatment-experienced patients

name: Ibalizumab

dosage.adult: 2000mg IV loading, then 800mg IV every 2 weeks

patient_counselling: Monoclonal antibody: binds domain 2 of CD4 receptor, blocking post-attachment steps without depleting CD4 cells.
pregnancy_category: First-in-class post-attachment inhibitor

name: Enfuvirtide
patient_counselling: Binds to HR1 region of gp41, preventing conformational change needed for membrane fusion.
pregnancy_category: SC injection BID - injection site reactions universal

name: Didanosine
patient_counselling: NRTI: inhibits HIV RT. Limited use due to toxicity profile.
pregnancy_category: Largely historical - replaced by less toxic NRTIs
overdose: Do NOT combine with TDF (increased didanosine levels)

name: Stavudine
patient_counselling: NRTI: similar to zidovudine. Limited use due to toxicity.
pregnancy_category: Historical NRTI - replaced by safer alternatives

name: Posaconazole
patient_counselling: Broadest spectrum triazole: covers Aspergillus, Candida, Mucorales. Extended-release tablet for better absorption.
brand_names: Bioavailability: solution 12% (take with fatty meal), EC tablet
pregnancy_category: Extended-release tablet: take with food~Avoid sirolimus and ergot alkaloids~Also available IV~Covers Mucorales (unlike other azoles)

name: Isavuconazole
patient_counselling: Broad-spectrum triazole with less QT prolongation than voriconazole. Active against Mucorales.
pregnancy_category: No QT prolongation (actually shortens QT - unique)

name: Micafungin
patient_counselling: Inhibits beta-(1,3)-D-glucan synthase. Longest half-life echinocandin.
pregnancy_category: Longest half-life echinocandin~No significant drug interactions~Also used as antifungal prophylaxis in HSCT

name: Anidulafungin
patient_counselling: Echinocandin: non-enzymatic degradation (no hepatic metabolism). Longest acting echinocandin.
pregnancy_category: Non-hepatic degradation - no CYP interactions~Longest half-life echinocandin~Best for esophageal candidiasis

name: Amphotericin B deoxycholate
patient_counselling: Binds ergosterol in fungal cell membrane, creating pores causing cell death. Gold standard for severe mycoses.
brand_names: IV only: t1/2 24h (but tissue effects prolonged)
pregnancy_category: Most nephrotoxic antifungal~Infusion-related reactions: premedicate with acetaminophen~Electrolyte wasting (K+, Mg2+)

name: Liposomal amphotericin B
patient_counselling: Lipid formulation: reduced nephrotoxicity compared to conventional amphotericin B. Same mechanism.
pregnancy_category: Less nephrotoxic than conventional amphotericin B~Higher doses tolerated~Same fungal spectrum~Cost is limitation

name: Flucytosine

dosage.adult: 100-150 mg/kg/day in 4 divided doses (with amphotericin B)

interactions: Amphotericin B (increases flucytosine levels by reducing renal clearance)
patient_counselling: Converted to 5-fluorouracil inside fungal cells. Combined with amphotericin B for synergy in cryptococcal meningitis.
pregnancy_category: Essential component of cryptococcal meningitis treatment (with amphotericin B)

name: Tavaborole

dosage.adult: Apply once daily to affected nails x 48 weeks

patient_counselling: Inhibits fungal protein synthesis by binding to leucyl-tRNA synthetase.
pregnancy_category: Topical alternative to oral antifungals for nail infections

name: Efinaconazole

dosage.adult: Apply once daily to affected nails x 48 weeks

patient_counselling: Topical triazole: inhibits ergosterol synthesis. High nail penetration.
pregnancy_category: Better nail penetration than ciclopirox~Once daily application~48-week treatment course~No systemic side effects

name: Ciclopirox

dosage.adult: 8% nail lacquer once daily x 48 weeks (nails)~Cream BID (skin)

patient_counselling: Chelates polyvalent cations, inhibiting metal-dependent enzymes in fungi.
pregnancy_category: Nail lacquer: once daily~Also available as cream for skin infections~No systemic absorption

name: Terbinafine topical
patient_counselling: Topical fungicidal: inhibits squalene epoxidase.
pregnancy_category: Fungicidal topical for dermatophyte infections
overdose: High cure rate for tinea pedis

name: Natamycin

dosage.adult: 1 drop q1-2h while awake x 14-21 days

patient_counselling: Polyene antifungal: binds ergosterol in fungal cell membranes.
pregnancy_category: For fungal keratitis only~Polyene class (same as amphotericin B)

name: Pegfilgrastim

dosage.adult: 6 mg SC once per chemo cycle (day 1 post-chemo)

patient_counselling: Pegylated filgrastim: extended half-life allows once-per-cycle dosing.
pregnancy_category: Once per cycle dosing - major convenience advantage~Start 24h after chemo~Bone pain most common~Do not use between 14 days before and 24h after chemo

name: Darbepoetin alfa

dosage.adult: 200 IU/kg SC weekly or 500 IU/kg q3 weeks

patient_counselling: Hyperglycosylated erythropoietin analogue with longer half-life. Stimulates red blood cell production.
pregnancy_category: Longer half-life than epoetin alfa (allows less frequent dosing)~Target Hgb 10-11 g/dL (do not exceed 12)
warnings: ESAs increase mortality in active malignancy - use lowest dose for shortest time

name: Epoetin alfa
patient_counselling: Recombinant human erythropoietin: stimulates erythropoiesis in bone marrow.
pregnancy_category: Shorter half-life than darbepoetin - requires more frequent dosing~Target Hgb 10-11 g/dL~ESAs increase mortality in active malignancy

name: Romiplostim
patient_counselling: TPO receptor agonist: stimulates megakaryocyte proliferation and platelet production.
pregnancy_category: Weekly SC injection~Titrate to platelet count 50,000-200,000~Bone marrow reticulin risk with prolonged use
warnings: Do not use to normalize platelets

name: Eltrombopag
interactions: Polyvalent cations (antacids, iron, calcium - separate by 4h)
patient_counselling: Oral TPO receptor agonist: binds transmembrane domain of TPO receptor.
pregnancy_category: Take on empty stomach (separate from polyvalent cations by 4h)
warnings: Hepatotoxicity and bone marrow reticulin risk
overdose: Also used in aplastic anemia (with immunosuppressive therapy)

name: Lipegfilgrastim

dosage.adult: 6 mg SC once per chemo cycle

patient_counselling: Long-acting PEGylated G-CSF. Similar to pegfilgrastim.
pregnancy_category: Once per cycle dosing~Similar efficacy to pegfilgrastim~Biosimilar alternative

name: Pertuzumab

dosage.adult: 840 mg IV loading, then 420 mg IV q3 weeks

patient_counselling: Binds HER2 domain II: prevents HER2 heterodimerization with HER3/other HER receptors. Complementary to trastuzumab.
pregnancy_category: Must be used with trastuzumab~Diarrhea most common (68%)~Cleopatra trial: improved PFS/OS in HER2+ MBC

name: Trastuzumab deruxtecan
patient_counselling: Anti-HER2 ADC: trastuzumab linked to topoisomerase I inhibitor via cleavable linker. Bystander effect kills adjacent HER2-low cells.
pregnancy_category: Bystander effect: effective even in HER2-low tumors~Interstitial lung disease risk (monitor respiratory symptoms)
warnings: DESTINY-Breast03: superior to T-DM1 in HER2+
overdose: Also effective in HER2-low breast cancer (DESTINY-Breast04)

name: Ado-trastuzumab emtansine
indications: HER2+ breast cancer (after progression on trastuzumab)
patient_counselling: Anti-HER2 ADC: trastuzumab linked to cytotoxic DM1 via non-cleavable linker.
pregnancy_category: Non-cleavable linker - no bystander effect (requires HER2 expression)

name: Olaratumab
patient_counselling: Anti-PDGFR-alpha: blocks PDGF receptor signaling. Added to doxorubicin for advanced STS. FDA approval withdrawn due to lack of OS benefit in confirmatory trial.
pregnancy_category: FDA approval withdrawn (no OS benefit in phase 3)
warnings: Was used with doxorubicin for advanced STS

name: Ramucirumab

dosage.adult: 8 mg/kg IV q2 weeks (gastric) or 10 mg/kg q2 weeks (NSCLC)

patient_counselling: Binds VEGFR2 directly, blocking VEGF ligand binding. Alternative to bevacizumab.
pregnancy_category: Anti-VEGFR2 (targets receptor vs ligand like bevacizumab)

name: Cetuximab

dosage.adult: 400 mg/m2 IV loading, then 250 mg/m2 weekly (or 500 mg/m2 q2 weeks)

patient_counselling: Binds EGFR, blocking downstream signaling. KRAS/NRAS wild-type required for efficacy in CRC.
pregnancy_category: REQUIRES RAS testing (KRAS/NRAS) - no benefit in mutant
warnings: Also blocks VEGF in combo with bevacizumab

name: Panitumumab
patient_counselling: Fully human anti-EGFR: lower immunogenicity than cetuximab. Same RAS testing requirement.
pregnancy_category: Fully human - lower infusion reaction rate than cetuximab

name: Atezolizumab
patient_counselling: PD-L1 inhibitor: blocks PD-L1 on tumor cells, preventing PD-1 engagement on T cells.
pregnancy_category: Anti-PD-L1 (vs anti-PD-1 for nivolumab/pembrolizumab)
warnings: Also blocks CD80/CD86 (B7 ligands) - may enhance immune response
overdose: Combo with bevacizumab for HCC and NSCLC

name: Ipilimumab
side_effects: Immune-mediated adverse events (more severe than PD-1 inhibitors)

dosage.adult: 3 mg/kg q3 weeks x4 (melanoma) or 1 mg/kg q6 weeks (with nivolumab)

patient_counselling: CTLA-4 inhibitor: blocks CTLA-4 inhibitory signal, enhancing T-cell activation. More toxic than PD-1 inhibitors.
pregnancy_category: Higher rate of immune-mediated AEs than PD-1 inhibitors~Colitis is most serious (check for perforation)~Hepatitis~Endocrinopathies
warnings: 1 mg/kg with nivolumab for many tumor types (lower dose = less toxicity)

name: Nivolumab + ipilimumab
side_effects: Immune-mediated adverse events (more than either alone)

dosage.adult: Nivolumab 1 mg/kg + ipilimumab 1 mg/kg q3 weeks x4, then nivolumab 240mg q2 weeks

patient_counselling: Dual checkpoint blockade: synergistic anti-tumor immunity by blocking both PD-1 and CTLA-4 pathways.
pregnancy_category: Combination more effective but more toxic than either alone~LFTs monitoring essential (hepatotoxicity common with combination)~For many tumor types now

name: Avelumab
patient_counselling: PD-L1 inhibitor: also mediates ADCC via Fc region (unique among checkpoint inhibitors).
pregnancy_category: ADCC capability (unique feature among checkpoint inhibitors)
warnings: Lower potency anti-PD-L1 compared to atezolizumab
overdose: Also approved with axitinib for RCC

name: Durvalumab

dosage.adult: 10 mg/kg IV q2 weeks or 1500 mg q4 weeks

patient_counselling: PD-L1 inhibitor: consolidation therapy after concurrent chemoRT in stage III NSCLC (PACIFIC trial).
pregnancy_category: PACIFIC trial: standard of care for stage III NSCLC after chemoRT~Also used in biliary tract cancer with gemcitabine/cisplatin

name: Erdafitinib
patient_counselling: Inhibits FGFR1-4: overcomes FGFR-altered resistance in urothelial carcinoma.
pregnancy_category: Hyperphosphatemia most common (phosphate binder if >5.5)

name: Larotrectinib
patient_counselling: Inhibits tropomyosin receptor kinases (TRK): effective in any tumor type with NTRK gene fusion.
pregnancy_category: Tumor-agnostic therapy: works in any cancer with TRK fusion~Response rate ~75% across tumor types

name: Entrectinib
patient_counselling: Inhibits TRK, ROS1, and ALK kinases. CNS-penetrant.
pregnancy_category: CNS-penetrant: effective in brain metastases~Tumor-agnostic for TRK fusions~Also covers ROS1 and ALK

name: Cilostazol
patient_counselling: PDE3 inhibitor: inhibits platelet aggregation and causes vasodilation. Improved walking distance in claudication.
pregnancy_category: CONTRAINDICATED in heart failure (mortality signal)
warnings: Avoid with other antiplatelets if possible

name: Ticlopidine
patient_counselling: First thienopyridine: irreversibly blocks P2Y12. Largely replaced by clopidogrel/prasugrel due to toxicity.
pregnancy_category: Historical - replaced by safer alternatives~Neutropenia risk (1-2%)~TTP risk~CBC monitoring required

name: Cangrelor

dosage.adult: 30 mcg/kg IV bolus then 4 mcg/kg/min infusion

patient_counselling: Reversible IV P2Y12 inhibitor: immediate onset, offset within 1 hour. Bridge between oral antiplatelet and procedure.
pregnancy_category: Fastest onset/offset of any P2Y12 inhibitor~IV only: for periprocedural use~Offset within 60 min of stopping infusion~Bridge to oral P2Y12 inhibitor

name: Vorapaxar
patient_counselling: PAR-1 (protease-activated receptor 1) antagonist: blocks thrombin-mediated platelet activation via a unique pathway.
pregnancy_category: Once daily dosing~Contraindicated in prior stroke/TIA (TRA 2P-TIMI 50: increased intracranial hemorrhage)

name: Rasburicase
patient_counselling: Converts uric acid to allantoin (more soluble and easily excreted). Prevents uric acid nephropathy in tumor lysis.
pregnancy_category: Prevents uric acid nephropathy in tumor lysis~Contraindicated in G6PD deficiency (severe hemolysis risk)
warnings: More effective than allopurinol for acute TLS

name: Pegloticase
patient_counselling: PEGylated uricase: rapidly lowers serum uric acid. For chronic gout refractory to conventional therapy. High immunogenicity.
pregnancy_category: For severe chronic refractory gout only~High infusion reaction rate (26%)~Anaphylaxis risk (monitor)~Serum uric acid should be <6 mg/mL (if rising = immunogenicity)

name: Lesinurad
patient_counselling: URAT1 and OAT4 inhibitor: blocks renal uric acid reabsorption, increasing uric acid excretion. Must use with XOI.
pregnancy_category: Must use with allopurinol or febuxostat (not as monotherapy)
warnings: Renal dose adjustment: avoid if CrCl <30

name: Benzbromarone
patient_counselling: Potent URAT1 inhibitor: blocks renal uric acid reabsorption. Available outside US.
pregnancy_category: Not available in US due to hepatotoxicity concerns

name: Probenecid
interactions: Penicillins (increases levels - historically used to prolong PCN effect)
patient_counselling: Blocks OAT1/OAT3 and URAT1, increasing renal uric acid excretion. Historically used to boost penicillin levels.
pregnancy_category: Historically used to prolong penicillin action~NSAIDs reduce uricosuric effect~Good for overproducers of uric acid~Prevent renal uric acid stones

name: Auranofin
patient_counselling: Gold compound: modulates immune function by inhibiting thioredoxin reductase. Historical DMARD.
pregnancy_category: Diarrhea limits tolerability~Largely replaced by biologics~Low-dose (3mg/day) better tolerated

name: Dapsone
patient_counselling: Inhibits bacterial folate synthesis (dapsone) and modulates neutrophil chemotaxis (anti-inflammatory at low doses).
pregnancy_category: G6PD testing essential (hemolytic anemia risk)~Methemoglobinemia: check methemoglobin level
warnings: Also used topically for acne (Aczone 5% gel)

name: Isotretinoin
patient_counselling: iPLEDGE program: must use two forms of contraception. Normalizes sebaceous gland function.
pregnancy_category: iPLEDGE program mandatory~Teratogenic: two forms of contraception required~Monthly pregnancy tests~Dry skin/lips universal~Depression monitoring (controversial)

name: Acitretin
interactions: Alcohol (prolongs elimination - avoid for 2 months after)
patient_counselling: Systemic retinoid for severe psoriasis. Contraindicated in pregnancy.
pregnancy_category: Avoid alcohol during and 2 months after treatment (prolongs half-life to ~160 days)

name: Tazarotene
patient_counselling: Topical retinoid: normalizes keratinization and reduces inflammation.
pregnancy_category: More potent topical retinoid than tretinoin~Also used for acne and photoaging

name: Tretinoin
interactions: Benzoyl peroxide (inactivates tretinoin if applied simultaneously)
patient_counselling: Topical retinoid: normalizes follicular keratinization, stimulates collagen synthesis.
pregnancy_category: Apply at bedtime~Avoid simultaneous benzoyl peroxide (separate by hours)

name: Adapalene
patient_counselling: Third-generation topical retinoid: selective for RAR-beta and RAR-gamma receptors. Less irritating than tretinoin.
pregnancy_category: Less irritating than tretinoin~Can combine with benzoyl peroxide (Epiduo)
warnings: Category C - relatively safe in pregnancy

name: Benzoyl peroxide
patient_counselling: Oxidizing agent: kills C. acnes via free radical formation. No antibiotic resistance.
pregnancy_category: Kills C. acnes without promoting resistance~Can bleach fabrics and hair~Separate from tretinoin application (by hours)~Start with 2.5% (less irritation)

name: Clindamycin topical
patient_counselling: Inhibits bacterial protein synthesis. Often combined with benzoyl peroxide to reduce resistance.
pregnancy_category: Usually combined with benzoyl peroxide~Monitor for C. difficile if systemic absorption (rare)

name: Mupirocin

dosage.adult: Apply TID to affected area (skin)~BID to nares x 5 days (decolonization)

patient_counselling: Inhibits bacterial isoleucyl-tRNA synthetase. Bactericidal against S. aureus and Streptococcus.
pregnancy_category: Excellent for impetigo~Nasal decolonization: BID x 5 days~Short-term use only (resistance with prolonged use)
warnings: Also available as cream and nasal ointment

name: Daptomycin topical
patient_counselling: Topical formulation of daptomycin for burn wound infections (investigational).
pregnancy_category: For burn wound infections (research stage)
warnings: May complement systemic daptomycin for burn patients

name: Triamcinolone acetonide

dosage.adult: Apply BID-QID to affected area (0.1% cream)

patient_counselling: Medium-potency topical corticosteroid for inflammatory dermatoses. Acetonide ester enhances skin penetration.
pregnancy_category: Medium potency - avoid face/groin~Also available as IM depot (Kenalog-40) and dental paste (Kenalog in Orabase)
warnings: Higher potency options available for severe disease

name: Betamethasone dipropionate
patient_counselling: See corticosteroids section
pregnancy_category: See corticosteroids section

name: Clobetasol

dosage.adult: Apply BID x 2 weeks max (0.05% cream)

patient_counselling: Superpotent topical corticosteroid: highest potency available. Limit use to 2 weeks.
pregnancy_category: Superpotent (Class I) - strongest available~Limit use to 2 weeks maximum~Avoid face, groin, axillae~Risk of HPA suppression if extensive use

name: Hydrocortisone (topical)
patient_counselling: Low-potency topical corticosteroid: safe for face, groin, and pediatric use.
pregnancy_category: Lowest potency - safe for sensitive areas

name: Pimecrolimus
patient_counselling: Selective calcineurin inhibitor: reduces T-cell mediated inflammation without skin atrophy risk.
pregnancy_category: No skin atrophy risk (unlike corticosteroids)
warnings: Safe for face, neck, and skin folds
overdose: Black box warning: theoretical lymphoma risk (not confirmed)

name: Tacrolimus (topical)
patient_counselling: Calcineurin inhibitor: reduces eczema flares and steroid use. More potent than pimecrolimus.
pregnancy_category: More potent than pimecrolimus for moderate-severe eczema~Application site burning common initially (decreases with use)
warnings: Black box warning: theoretical lymphoma risk (not confirmed)

name: Brimonidine
patient_counselling: Reduces aqueous humor production and increases uveoscleral outflow.
pregnancy_category: BID dosing~Can cause allergic follicular conjunctivitis~Less effective than prostaglandins~Can cross BBB (drowsiness)

name: Dorzolamide
patient_counselling: Inhibits carbonic anhydrase II in ciliary body, reducing aqueous humor production.
pregnancy_category: TID dosing disadvantage~Ocular stinging common~Caution in renal impairment~Can combine with timolol (Cosopt)

name: Brinzolamide
patient_counselling: Carbonic anhydrase inhibitor with suspension formulation (less stinging than dorzolamide).
pregnancy_category: BID dosing (vs dorzolamide TID)~Less stinging than dorzolamide~Suspension formulation

name: Pilocarpine
patient_counselling: Contracts ciliary muscle, opening trabecular meshwork and increasing aqueous outflow. Miotic.
pregnancy_category: For angle-closure emergency (pupillary block)~Miosis causes brow ache and blurred vision~Short-acting: multiple daily doses~Also used for dry mouth (Salagen 5mg TID)

name: Acetazolamide
patient_counselling: Inhibits carbonic anhydrase, reducing aqueous humor production and causing metabolic acidosis.
pregnancy_category: Paresthesias very common (tingling in fingers/toes)
warnings: Also used for altitude sickness prophylaxis
Metabolic acidosis expected (bicarbonate supplementation if symptomatic)
overdose: Also used for idiopathic intracranial hypertension

name: Methazolamide
patient_counselling: Carbonic anhydrase inhibitor with better ocular penetration than acetazolamide.
pregnancy_category: Longer half-life than acetazolamide (BID vs QID)

name: Brimonidine + timolol
patient_counselling: Fixed combination: reduces aqueous humor production via dual mechanism.
pregnancy_category: BID dosing convenience~Dual mechanism better than monotherapy~Avoid in reactive airway disease

name: Latanoprost + timolol
patient_counselling: Fixed combination for maximum IOP reduction.
brand_names: Iris pigmentation risk from latanoprost component
pregnancy_category: C

name: Oxybutynin
patient_counselling: Blocks M3 receptors on detrusor smooth muscle, reducing involuntary bladder contractions.
pregnancy_category: IR: BID-TID dosing~XL: once daily (better tolerability)
warnings: Patch: fewer GI effects than oral

name: Solifenacin
patient_counselling: Selective M3 muscarinic antagonist for bladder relaxation. Better GI tolerability than oxybutynin.
pregnancy_category: Once daily dosing~Less dry mouth than oxybutynin~Long half-life allows once daily

name: Fesoterodine
patient_counselling: Prodrug converted to active metabolite (5-HMT) by esterases. Similar efficacy to tolterodine but more flexible dosing.
pregnancy_category: Flexible dosing 4-8mg daily~Also available as ER formulation

name: Darifenacin
patient_counselling: Selective M3 receptor antagonist: most M3-selective antimuscarinic for OAB.
pregnancy_category: Most M3-selective antimuscarinic~CYP2D6 poor metabolizers: max 7.5mg

name: Tolterodine
patient_counselling: Blocks muscarinic receptors on detrusor muscle. Active metabolite (5-HMT) also pharmacologically active.
pregnancy_category: IR: BID dosing; XL: once daily
warnings: CYP2D6 poor metabolizers have higher levels
Also available with tolterodine LA (IM monthly)

name: Dutasteride
patient_counselling: Dual 5-alpha reductase inhibitor (type 1 and 2): more complete DHT suppression than finasteride.
pregnancy_category: Very long half-life: effects persist months after discontinuation
warnings: Dual type 1+2 inhibition (vs finasteride type 2 only)

name: Alfuzosin
patient_counselling: Uroselective alpha-1 antagonist with less effect on blood pressure.
pregnancy_category: Uroselective properties~Less orthostatic hypotension than non-selective alpha blockers

name: Silodosin
patient_counselling: Most alpha-1A selective blocker: highest rate of retrograde ejaculation but least orthostatic hypotension.
pregnancy_category: Most alpha-1A selective - retrograde ejaculation in 28% but usually tolerable
overdose: No dose adjustment in renal impairment

name: Doxazosin ER
patient_counselling: None significant

name: Avanafil
patient_counselling: Most PDE5-selective inhibitor: fastest onset (15 min) and fewest visual side effects.
pregnancy_category: Fastest onset PDE5i (15 min)

name: Vardenafil
patient_counselling: PDE5 inhibitor. Also available as orally disintegrating tablet (Levitra ODT).
pregnancy_category: ODT formulation available (no water needed)

name: Oxybutynin topical

dosage.adult: Apply to abdomen, upper arms, or buttocks daily

patient_counselling: Transdermal formulation: bypasses first-pass metabolism, reducing systemic side effects (especially dry mouth).
pregnancy_category: Less dry mouth than oral (27% vs 94%)~Apply to dry, intact skin~Change patch twice weekly

name: Desmopressin nasal
patient_counselling: Nasal formulation: better absorption than oral for enuresis and DI.
pregnancy_category: Nasal spray for enuresis and DI
warnings: More effective than oral for DI

name: Midodrine
patient_counselling: Prodrug converted to desglymidodrine: alpha-1 agonist causing arterial/venous constriction.
pregnancy_category: Take during daytime only - last dose at least 4h before bedtime~Avoid supine position~Monitor supine BP

name: Droxidopa
patient_counselling: Prodrug converted to norepinephrine in vivo. Increases peripheral vascular resistance.
pregnancy_category: Take during daytime only~Avoid late evening dosing (supine hypertension)

name: Ondansetron (PRV)
patient_counselling: See antiemetics section
pregnancy_category: See antiemetics section

name: Minoxidil
patient_counselling: Opens ATP-sensitive potassium channels in hair follicles, prolonging anagen phase and stimulating growth.
pregnancy_category: 5% foam for men, 2% liquid for women~Apply BID to scalp~Results take 4-6 months~Hypertrichosis possible
warnings: Also available as oral low-dose for refractory alopecia (off-label)

name: Spironolactone (topical)
patient_counselling: Topical anti-androgen: blocks DHT receptor in hair follicle. Alternative to oral spironolactone.
pregnancy_category: For female pattern hair loss (topical formulation under investigation)
warnings: Less systemic effects than oral spironolactone

name: Cyproterone
patient_counselling: Competitive androgen receptor antagonist and progestogen. Blocks testosterone/DHT effects.
pregnancy_category: Not available in US (hepatotoxicity concerns)
warnings: Used in Europe for severe hirsutism and acne
overdose: Combined with ethinyl estradiol as Dianette/Diane-35

name: Eflornithine

dosage.adult: Apply BID to affected facial areas

patient_counselling: Inhibits ornithine decarboxylase, reducing hair growth rate. Slows (does not remove) facial hair.
pregnancy_category: Apply BID - results take 8-24 weeks
warnings: Slows hair growth (does not remove existing hair)
overdose: Combine with other hair removal methods for best results

name: Calcipotriene
patient_counselling: Synthetic vitamin D analogue: inhibits keratinocyte proliferation and promotes differentiation.
pregnancy_category: Apply BID to affected areas~Calcium monitoring if >100g/week used~Also available as combination with betamethasone (Enstilar foam)

name: Calcipotriene/betamethasone

dosage.adult: Apply BID for up to 4 weeks

patient_counselling: Fixed combination: calcipotriene for keratinocyte normalization + betamethasone for anti-inflammation.
pregnancy_category: Foam formulation: easy application
overdose: Very effective combination for plaque psoriasis

name: Tacrolimus (topical)
patient_counselling: See dermatology section
pregnancy_category: See dermatology section

name: Cidofovir

dosage.adult: 5 mg/kg IV weekly x2, then q2 weeks (with probenecid and hydration)

patient_counselling: Nucleotide analogue: does not require viral kinase for activation. Active against CMV and adenovirus.
brand_names: IV: t1/2 2.6h (but intracellular t1/2 much longer)
pregnancy_category: Probenecid pre-treatment required (reduces nephrotoxicity)
pharmacokinetics: For CMV retinitis in AIDS patients

name: Foscarnet
patient_counselling: Directly inhibits viral DNA polymerase without requiring phosphorylation. Pyrophosphate analogue.
pregnancy_category: Does not require viral thymidine kinase for activation (active against TK-deficient strains)

name: Entecavir
drug_class: HBV DNA polymerase reverse transcriptase inhibitor
patient_counselling: Potent nucleoside analogue: inhibits all three activities of HBV polymerase (base priming, reverse transcription, DNA synthesis).
pregnancy_category: More potent than lamivudine
warnings: Low barrier to resistance (if lamivudine-resistant: 1mg daily)

name: Tenofovir (for HBV)
patient_counselling: See antiretrovirals section
pregnancy_category: See antiretrovirals section

name: Pegylated interferon alpha
patient_counselling: Pegylated interferon-alpha: stimulates innate and adaptive immune response against hepatitis virus.
pregnancy_category: Pegylation extends half-life to allow weekly dosing
warnings: Flu-like symptoms very common (manage with acetaminophen)
pharmacokinetics: Mostly historical for HCV (replaced by DAAs)

name: Sofosbuvir/velpatasvir

dosage.adult: 400/100mg daily x12 weeks (with or without ribavirin)

patient_counselling: Sofosbuvir: NS5B polymerase inhibitor. Velpatasvir: NS5A inhibitor. Pan-genotypic cure.
pregnancy_category: Pan-genotypic HCV cure (95%+ SVR)
warnings: Amiodarone interaction: severe bradycardia - avoid combination
overdose: 12 weeks standard, 16 weeks with ribavirin for cirrhosis

name: Glecaprevir/pibrentasvir
patient_counselling: Glecaprevir: NS3/4A protease inhibitor. Pibrentasvir: NS5A inhibitor (pan-genotypic). High barrier to resistance.
pregnancy_category: Pan-genotypic: 8 weeks for non-cirrhotic treatment-naive
pharmacokinetics: High SVR rates across all genotypes

name: Voxilaprevir/sofosbuvir/velpatasvir
patient_counselling: Triple DAA combination for treatment-experienced patients with NS5A resistance.
pregnancy_category: For retreatment of HCV after prior DAA failure

name: Ledipasvir/sofosbuvir
patient_counselling: Ledipasvir: NS5A inhibitor. Sofosbuvir: NS5B polymerase inhibitor. Effective for GT1.
pregnancy_category: First combination single-tablet DAA cure for HCV GT1
overdose: Also effective for GT4, GT5, GT6 (pan-genotypic now superseded by Epclusa)

name: Daclatasvir/sofosbuvir
patient_counselling: Daclatasvir: NS5A inhibitor. Sofosbuvir: NS5B inhibitor. Pan-genotypic combination.
pregnancy_category: Less commonly used now (superseded by fixed-dose combinations)

name: Elbasvir/grazoprevir
patient_counselling: Elbasvir: NS5A inhibitor. Grazoprevir: NS3/4A protease inhibitor. Effective for GT1/4.
pregnancy_category: For HCV GT1 and GT4
overdose: 12-16 weeks (16 weeks if GT1a with NS5A resistance-associated substitutions)

name: Ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir + dasabuvir
patient_counselling: Ombitasvir: NS5A. Paritaprevir: NS3/4A (boosted by ritonavir). Dasabuvir: NS5B (non-nucleoside).
pregnancy_category: 2D regimen without dasabuvir for GT1b

name: Dorzavir/ritonavir
patient_counselling: See antiretrovirals section
pregnancy_category: See antiretrovirals section

name: Cyclopentolate
patient_counselling: Short-acting mydriatic/cycloplegic for refraction. Effects wear off in 24-48h.
pregnancy_category: Shorter acting than atropine

name: Phenylephrine
patient_counselling: Alpha-1 agonist: contracts dilator pupillae causing pupil dilation without cycloplegia.
pregnancy_category: Mydriasis WITHOUT cycloplegia (advantage for retinal exam)

name: Prostaglandin analogues (class)
patient_counselling: Class: increases uveoscleral outflow. First-line for glaucoma. Includes latanoprost, bimatoprost, travoprost, tafluprost.
pregnancy_category: Once daily dosing advantage
overdose: First-line for most open-angle glaucoma patients

name: Bimatoprost

dosage.adult: 1 drop in affected eye(s) once daily in the evening

patient_counselling: Prostaglandin analogue: increases uveoscleral outflow. Also promotes eyelash growth.
pregnancy_category: Once daily dosing
overdose: Also used cosmetically for eyelash growth (Latisse)

name: Travoprost

dosage.adult: 1 drop in affected eye(s) once daily in the evening

patient_counselling: Prostaglandin analogue: selective FP receptor agonist.
pregnancy_category: Once daily dosing

name: Tafluprost

dosage.adult: 1 drop in affected eye(s) once daily

patient_counselling: Preservative-free prostaglandin analogue. Better for ocular surface disease.
pregnancy_category: Preservative-free single-use vials
warnings: Better for patients with ocular surface disease

name: Brimonidine/timolol
patient_counselling: See glaucoma section
pregnancy_category: See glaucoma section

name: Dorzolamide/timolol
patient_counselling: Fixed combination: CAI (dorzolamide) + beta-blocker (timolol). Dual mechanism IOP reduction.
pregnancy_category: Ocular stinging common initially
warnings: Avoid in reactive airway disease (timolol component)

name: Netarsudil

dosage.adult: 1 drop in affected eye(s) once daily in the evening

patient_counselling: Inhibits Rho kinase/ROCK: increases conventional outflow through trabecular meshwork.
pregnancy_category: Once daily dosing
warnings: Novel mechanism: targets trabecular meshwork directly
pharmacokinetics: Also available as combination with latanoprost (Rocklatan)

name: Netarsudil/latanoprost

dosage.adult: 1 drop in affected eye(s) once daily in the evening

patient_counselling: Triple mechanism: increased uveoscleral outflow + trabecular meshwork + decreased aqueous production.
pregnancy_category: Once daily dosing
overdose: Most effective fixed combination for IOP reduction

name: Levobunolol
patient_counselling: Non-selective beta-blocker: reduces aqueous humor production.
pregnancy_category: Similar to timolol but less commonly used

name: Metipranolol
patient_counselling: Non-selective beta-blocker. Less commonly used.
pregnancy_category: Less commonly used than timolol

name: Carteolol
patient_counselling: Non-selective beta-blocker with intrinsic sympathomimetic activity: less bradycardia than other beta-blockers.
pregnancy_category: ISA property: less effect on heart rate

name: Levocabastine
patient_counselling: Selective H1 receptor antagonist: blocks histamine-mediated allergic eye symptoms.
pregnancy_category: Fast onset for acute allergic symptoms
warnings: Can use with other eye drops (wait 5 min)

name: Emadastine
patient_counselling: Selective H1 antagonist with mast cell stabilizing properties.
pregnancy_category: Fast onset
overdose: Can use with mast cell stabilizers

name: Azelastine (ophthalmic)
patient_counselling: H1 antagonist and mast cell stabilizer. Also available as nasal spray.
pregnancy_category: Dual mechanism: antihistamine + mast cell stabilizer

name: Olopatadine (ophthalmic)
patient_counselling: H1 antagonist with mast cell stabilizing properties.
pregnancy_category: Once daily available (Pataday)
warnings: Dual mechanism: antihistamine + mast cell stabilizer

name: Ketotifen (ophthalmic)
patient_counselling: H1 antagonist and mast cell stabilizer. Available OTC.
pregnancy_category: Also available as oral (Ketotifen oral for mastocytosis)

name: Pemirolast
patient_counselling: Prevents mast cell degranulation and histamine release.
pregnancy_category: QID dosing (more frequent than alternatives)

name: Nepenthes
patient_counselling: Lubricant eye drops: provide temporary relief of dry eye symptoms. Various formulations available.
pregnancy_category: Use as needed
warnings: Artificial tears: various formulations (aqueous, gel, ointment)
overdose: Nighttime ointment for severe dry eye

name: Hydroxypropyl methylcellulose
patient_counselling: Viscous lubricant: provides longer lasting relief than aqueous drops.
pregnancy_category: More viscous than saline drops

name: Carmellose sodium
patient_counselling: Cellulose derivative: lubricates and protects ocular surface.
pregnancy_category: Good for moderate to severe dry eye
warnings: Also available as preservative-free unit dose

name: Polyvinyl alcohol
patient_counselling: Viscoelastic polymer: provides temporary relief of dry eye symptoms.
pregnancy_category: Lowest viscosity artificial tears

name: Sodium hyaluronate
patient_counselling: Highly hydrophilic polymer: binds water and provides long-lasting hydration of ocular surface.
pregnancy_category: Binds water effectively
overdose: Good for moderate to severe dry eye

name: Vedolizumab

dosage.adult: 300mg IV at weeks 0~2~6 then q8 weeks

patient_counselling: Blocks gut-specific alpha-4-beta-7 integrin: prevents lymphocyte trafficking to gut. Gut-selective immunosuppression.
pregnancy_category: Gut-selective: lower infection risk than systemic immunosuppressants

name: Mirikizumab

dosage.adult: 300mg SC at weeks 0~4~8, then 100mg q4 weeks

patient_counselling: Selective IL-23 p19 inhibitor: targets pathogenic Th17 cells. More selective than ustekinumab.
pregnancy_category: Selective IL-23: more targeted than ustekinumab
warnings: Long half-life allows q4 week maintenance

name: Filgotinib
patient_counselling: Selective JAK1 inhibitor: preferentially targets JAK1-mediated signaling. Potentially fewer off-target effects than non-selective JAK inhibitors.
pregnancy_category: Selective JAK1: potentially better safety profile

name: Ozanimod

dosage.adult: 0.92mg daily x7 days, then 0.92mg daily maintenance

patient_counselling: S1P receptor modulator: sequesters lymphocytes in lymph nodes, preventing gut inflammation. Oral small molecule.
pregnancy_category: Oral S1P modulator for UC
warnings: First-dose heart rate monitoring (titration reduces bradycardia)

name: Ponesimod
patient_counselling: Selective S1P1 modulator: sequesters lymphocytes. Alternative to ozanimod.
pregnancy_category: Selective S1P1: newer agent

name: Vonoprazan
patient_counselling: P-CAB: competitively inhibits H+/K+-ATPase. Faster onset, more potent acid suppression than PPIs. No CYP2C19 dependence.
pregnancy_category: Faster onset and more potent than PPIs
overdose: Available as triple therapy for H. pylori
pharmacokinetics: Also available as single-agent for GERD

name: Tegoprazan
patient_counselling: P-CAB: competitively inhibits H+/K+-ATPase. Korean approval. Faster onset than PPIs.
pregnancy_category: P-CAB class agent

name: Voclosporin
patient_counselling: Calcineurin inhibitor: blocks T-cell activation. Lupus nephritis-specific (combined with MMF).
pregnancy_category: Combined with mycophenolate for lupus nephritis
overdose: More specific for LN than systemic CsA

name: Sparsentan
patient_counselling: Dual receptor antagonist: blocks both endothelin-1 (ETA) and angiotensin II (AT1). Reduces proteinuria.
pregnancy_category: Dual mechanism: more proteinuria reduction than RAS blockade alone

name: Atrasentan
patient_counselling: Selective ETA antagonist: reduces proteinuria and inflammation in diabetic kidney disease.
pregnancy_category: Selective ETA: less fluid retention than dual ETA/ETB antagonists
warnings: Fluid retention: monitor weight and edema
overdose: Also in trials for IgA nephropathy

name: Dapagliflozin (for CKD)
patient_counselling: Inhibits SGLT2: reduces intraglomerular pressure, tubuloglomerular feedback. Renal and CV benefits independent of diabetes.
brand_names: Onset 1-2 weeks for glucose; 4-12 weeks for renal benefits
pregnancy_category: SGLT2 inhibitor with proven renal benefits
warnings: Stop if eGFR <20 (or <25 per some guidelines)

name: Empagliflozin (for CKD)
patient_counselling: Inhibits SGLT2: similar renal benefits to dapagliflozin.
pregnancy_category: SGLT2 inhibitor with proven renal and CV benefits

name: Bexagliflozin
patient_counselling: SGLT2 inhibitor: reduces glucose reabsorption in proximal tubule. Novel structural class.
pregnancy_category: SGLT2 inhibitor with unique chemical structure

name: Sotagliflozin
side_effects: Diabetic ketoacidosis (higher risk than other SGLT2i)
patient_counselling: Dual SGLT1/2 inhibitor: blocks intestinal glucose absorption (SGLT1) + renal glucose reabsorption (SGLT2). Unique for T1DM.
pregnancy_category: Dual SGLT1/2: only SGLT inhibitor approved for T1DM
warnings: Higher DKA risk: strict ketone monitoring during illness

name: Survodutide
patient_counselling: Dual GLP-1/glucagon agonist: glucagon receptor activation increases energy expenditure and fat oxidation. Promising phase 3 data.
pregnancy_category: Dual GLP-1/glucagon: potentially superior to GLP-1 alone for weight loss
warnings: Glucagon component may increase hepatic fat oxidation
pharmacokinetics: Also being studied for MASH (metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis)

name: Orforglipron
patient_counselling: Oral non-peptide GLP-1 agonist: first oral GLP-1 in advanced trials. No peptide degradation issues.
pregnancy_category: Oral GLP-1: major convenience advantage over injectable
pharmacokinetics: If approved: first oral non-peptide GLP-1 for obesity/T2DM

name: Danuglipron
patient_counselling: Oral non-peptide GLP-1 agonist: BID dosing with food.
pregnancy_category: Oral GLP-1 with BID dosing

name: Efinopegdutide
patient_counselling: Long-acting PEGylated GLP-1 agonist: reduces liver fat and inflammation in MASH.
pregnancy_category: PEGylation extends half-life for weekly dosing
pharmacokinetics: Also reduces body weight and HbA1c

name: Semaglutide (for MASH)
patient_counselling: See GLP-1 section
pregnancy_category: See GLP-1 section

name: Lanifibranor
patient_counselling: Pan-PPAR agonist: activates PPARα/δ/γ. Reduces liver fibrosis and inflammation. NASH resolution.
pregnancy_category: Pan-PPAR agonist: addresses multiple metabolic pathways
warnings: First drug to show fibrosis improvement in MASH phase 2b
overdose: Also reduces triglycerides and increases HDL

name: Resmetirom
patient_counselling: Selective THR-β agonist: activates hepatic thyroid hormone receptor to reduce liver fat and inflammation. First FDA-approved MASH drug.
pregnancy_category: First FDA-approved drug for MASH with fibrosis (March 2024)
pharmacokinetics: Also reduces LDL cholesterol and triglycerides

name: Tirzepatide (for MASH)
patient_counselling: See GLP-1 section
pregnancy_category: See GLP-1 section

name: CagriSema
patient_counselling: Combination of semaglutide (GLP-1) + cagrilintide (amylin analogue): complementary appetite suppression. Greater weight loss than semaglutide alone.
pregnancy_category: Amylin analogue + GLP-1: dual appetite suppression
overdose: Up to 23% weight loss in phase 2

name: Survodutide (MASH)
patient_counselling: See above
pregnancy_category: See above

name: Pegozafermin
patient_counselling: FGF21 analogue: improves metabolic parameters, reduces liver fat and fibrosis. Novel mechanism.
pregnancy_category: FGF21 analogue: novel mechanism for MASH
warnings: Phase 2b data: NASH resolution + fibrosis improvement
overdose: Also reduces triglycerides and body weight

name: Lerodalcibep
patient_counselling: PCSK9 inhibitor: binds and inhibits PCSK9, increasing LDL receptor recycling. Longer half-life than evolocumab/alirocumab.
pregnancy_category: Fusion protein with albumin: extended half-life
warnings: Every 4 weeks dosing (less frequent than alternatives)

name: Inclisiran

dosage.adult: 284mg SC at months 0~3, then q6 months

patient_counselling: siRNA: silences PCSK9 mRNA in hepatocytes. Twice-yearly dosing for sustained LDL reduction.
pregnancy_category: siRNA mechanism: longest-acting lipid-lowering therapy
warnings: Twice-yearly SC dosing after initial loading

name: Bempedoic acid
patient_counselling: Inhibits ACL: upstream of HMG-CoA reductase. Reduces cholesterol synthesis without muscle-related side effects (not activated in muscle).
pregnancy_category: Prodrug activated in liver (not muscle): avoids myalgia
overdose: Uric acid elevation: monitor and manage gout risk
pharmacokinetics: Also available as fixed-dose with ezetimibe (Nexlizet)

name: Bempedoic acid/ezetimibe
generic_name: Fixed-dose combination (ACL inhibitor + cholesterol absorption inhibitor)
patient_counselling: Dual mechanism: reduces cholesterol synthesis (bempedoic acid) + absorption (ezetimibe). Additive LDL reduction.
pregnancy_category: Fixed-dose combination for statin-intolerant or add-on therapy
overdose: Gout prophylaxis if elevated uric acid

name: Pemafibrate
patient_counselling: Selective PPARα modulator: activates PPARα with improved safety vs fibrates. Potent triglyceride reduction.
pregnancy_category: Selective SPPARMα: improved safety over gemfibrozil/fenofibrate
overdose: Also increases HDL and reduces apoC-III

name: Icosapent ethyl
patient_counselling: Purified EPA: reduces triglycerides, inflammation, and CV events. REDUCE-IT trial: 25% relative risk reduction in MACE.
pregnancy_category: Purified EPA: distinct from fish oil (contains EPA+DHA)
warnings: CV benefit proven in REDUCE-IT (controversial mineral oil placebo)
overdose: Also reduces hsCRP and inflammatory markers

name: Omacor
patient_counselling: See omega-3 section
pregnancy_category: See omega-3 section

name: Volanesorsen

dosage.adult: 300mg SC weekly x4 weeks, then 300mg q2 weeks

patient_counselling: Antisense oligonucleotide: inhibits apoC-III synthesis. ApoC-III inhibits lipoprotein lipase; reducing it accelerates TG clearance.
pregnancy_category: Antisense mechanism: reduces apoC-III levels by 70-80%
pharmacokinetics: For severe FCS (TG >500 mg/dL despite fibrates)

name: Olezarsen
patient_counselling: Next-gen apoC-III inhibitor: less frequent dosing than volanesorsen. Higher potency.
pregnancy_category: Next-gen ASO: q4 week dosing (vs q2 weeks volanesorsen)

name: Lomitapide
patient_counselling: MTP inhibitor: blocks VLDL assembly in liver and chylomicron assembly in intestine. Reduces LDL independently of LDL receptors.
pregnancy_category: For HoFH: reduces LDL by 40-50%
